reference_stateful_result.closed_cause: missing official stateful core as the sole explanation

one_changed_factor.name: unroll_length
one_changed_factor.rationale: The official stateful core was proven active but remained below Random. The constrained harness still used unroll 20 while the official SILG default is 80. Increase only the learner trajectory horizon while preserving the verified stateful path and all other resource constraints.

factor_routing_proof: --stateful appears in every seed training command
--unroll_length 80 appears in every seed training command
every checkpoint contains core.* LSTM weights
every seed diagnostic has recurrent_state_l2_after_mean greater than zero
required_artifacts: three checkpoints with actual frame count, bytes and SHA-256
per-seed peak RSS and training wall time
policy entropy, recurrent-state norms and episode termination statistics
raw install, patch, training, evaluation and qualification logs
pip freeze, file-size manifest and SHA-256 manifest
qualification: all three stateful unroll-80 checkpoints complete
correct win rate greater than random
three-seed mean improves and minimum seed does not regress unacceptably
resource increase is recorded and interpreted
failure_policy: If factor routing fails, repair only routing and repeat. If stateful unroll=80 is valid but Correct remains at or below Random, reject unroll shortage as the sole cause and choose exactly one next learner-optimization factor from learning rate, gradient clipping, or optimizer/checkpoint restore using preserved code and log evidence. Do not end with a negative result alone.
